subject: Request: sample onboarding controls & training logs
messages:
From: audits@brightline-security.com
To: markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-12-09T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: sample onboarding controls & training logs

Markus,

Thanks again for taking the time earlier. As part of the SOC 2 readiness review for Acme Health we need a small set of personnel controls artifacts to validate onboarding/offboarding and training coverage. Can you provide the following for our sample pull:  

- Training attendance/logs for mandatory security training for the last 12 months (machine-readable preferred; CSV or XLSX).
- Redacted background-check evidence for three hires (redact PII per our standard: SSNs, DOB; leave hire dates and role).
- Deprovisioning/offboarding logs for the three sample identities showing system access removal dates and ticket links.
- HR policy excerpt that defines rehire/termination process (one page is fine).

Deliverables can be uploaded to a shared Drive folder or sent via secure transfer. Ideally we’d like these items by end of week (2027-12-13) to stay on schedule. If there are any constraints on redaction or legal review, let us know and we can accept a staggered delivery.

Also copy Rachel Lin from Acme Health on any clarifications.

Best,
Aaron Mills
Brightline Security — Senior Auditor
audits@brightline-security.com

From: markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
To: audits@brightline-security.com; rachel.lin@acmehealth.com
Cc: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com; monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-12-09T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: sample onboarding controls & training logs

Aaron / Rachel,

Appreciate the clear list — we can assemble those artifacts. Quick clarifying items before we start:  

1) For the three sample hires, do you want them to be current employees only, or a mix that includes one leaver from the last 12 months? We can do either; including one leaver helps validate offboarding.
2) Redaction standard: we’ll follow your SSN/DOB redaction note. Confirm if we should also redact personal email addresses, or leave corporate emails visible for access logs correlation.
3) Preferred format: we’ll stage machine-readable logs (CSV) and a single PDF bundle for HR policy excerpts.

I’ve attached an index CSV (artifact_index.csv) with the artifacts we expect to produce and a proposed delivery schedule. Kimberly and Monica — can you confirm availability to pull BG checks and offboarding tickets? I’ll coordinate upload to the shared Drive once we have the artifacts.

Target: initial upload by 2027-12-11, complete set by 2027-12-13. If anything slips, we’ll flag and provide interim items.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Security Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: artifact_index.csv (stub)

From: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
To: markus.klein@redwoodinference.com; monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-12-10T14:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: sample onboarding controls & training logs

Markus / Monica,

We’ll pull the records. Proposed three-sample set:  
- Sample 1: Current full-time engineer (hire: 2026-04-19)
- Sample 2: Current contractor (hire: 2027-01-10)
- Sample 3: Terminated headcount (termination: 2027-07-08) — includes offboarding ticket and deprovision timestamps.

Notes on redaction: per Brightline request we will remove SSN and DOB. I recommend leaving corporate email addresses visible so auditors can reconcile access logs to identity. If Brightline insists on redacting corporate emails, we’ll provide a separate mapping table internally (redacted_id -> corporate email) under a separate secure transfer.

We have HR export access and can produce: training_attendance_2026-12_to_2027-12.csv, offboard_logs_sample.csv, and the redacted background checks bundle. I’m attaching our internal redaction guidance for legal review (redaction_guidelines.pdf).

Will start pulls today and aim to hand off to Markus for upload by EOD 2027-12-11.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
People Ops Manager — Redwood Inference
Attachment: redaction_guidelines.pdf (stub)

From: markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
To: audits@brightline-security.com; rachel.lin@acmehealth.com
Cc: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com; monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-12-11T16:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: sample onboarding controls & training logs

Aaron / Rachel,

We’ve uploaded the initial sample bundle to a shared Drive folder (link below) and attached a compact set to this message. Deliverables included:  

- training_certificates_2026-2027.pdf — consolidated completion certificates for required security training (redacted where appropriate).
- offboard_logs_sample.csv — system deprovision timestamps and ticket references for sample 3.
- redacted_bg_checks_sample.zip — three redacted background-check scans (SSN/DOB removed).
- artifact_index.csv — index of files and brief notes.

Per our earlier note, corporate email addresses are left intact to enable log reconciliation; personal emails and SSNs are removed. If Brightline prefers corporate-email redaction, we can provide a mapping under secure transfer.  

We’ve also created a short Jira task to track follow-ups: SUP-8721. If you need additional samples (e.g., higher-volume exports or role-based breakdowns), tell us which slices you want and we’ll schedule the pull.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B_onboarding_audit_samples

Regards,
Markus Klein
Head of Security Operations — Redwood Inference
Attachments: redacted_bg_checks_sample.zip; training_certificates_2026-2027.pdf; offboard_logs_sample.csv

Onward notes (internal):
- Monica to retain copy of unredacted BG checks in secure HR vault for compliance retention policy.
- Kimberly to record the artifact handover timestamp in the retention ledger (HubSpot:hs_1827334).
